notes: Loop 2 (loop 1: 7.4). Checked src/sim/*.ts, sim.test.ts (45 pass, now with behaviour tests), the German demo (seed 36, report.txt:302-470), de/en briefs, Neukölln vs Charlottenburg, all 8 events over 60 seeds, and a 240-run sweep. All six loop-1 items were addressed; duplicate lines only partly. Strong: the demo now tells a story (Jan tells, Murat returns, Greta tries the new café). The German lines sound spoken ('läppert sich', 'Gewohnheitstier'). The caveat says rules played the customers, not an AI, in all four languages. Briefs carry nothing private and ask for German answers. The Kiez mix moves (retirees: 42 in Charlottenburg vs 19 in Neukölln, per 360) and is labelled a rough guess. Held back: persona templates repeat. In the demo, Noor and Jan get the same nurse sentence and Chiara and Jan share a memory; 60 of 240 runs share a job. The demo interview has three identical pairs, and Noor's answer names the new café she never visited. New contradictions show in the demo itself (Jan's 'Zum ersten Mal' after a try; 'Paweł erwähnt ständig' while Paweł has forgotten). 3 of 8 events change nothing in a rule-based run. Kiez flavour is only the mix and the name.
improvements: src/sim/personas.ts:262-266 (job, routine, quirk drawn independently per persona) and finish() (memory = pick(...)): imagined people within one run share their text. In the shipped /r#demo, Noor and Jan both 'ist Krankenpfleger(in) mit weniger Stunden, solange das Jüngste in der Kita eingewöhnt wird', and Murat is a nurse too (3 of 6). Chiara and Jan share the birthday-candle memory. Over 240 runs (4 Kieze × 60 seeds): 60 share a job sentence, 114 a memory, 117 a routine. The cards also contradict themselves. 52 'regular (you come in most days)' personas have a once-a-week routine (Leyla in Charlottenburg, seed 1: 'Isst einmal die Woche spät zu Mittag'). 67 'Das Geld ist knapp' personas are the run's top spender, above €9.90 (Mehmet, €13.30). Fix: draw job, routine, quirk and memory without replacement within a run; derive price sensitivity from usual spend vs the base spend (or say why); pick routines that match the relationship. Criterion: personas, not caricatures. Check: a sim test over seeds 1-60 × 4 Kieze with no repeated job, routine, quirk or memory in a run and no 'most days' regular on a weekly routine.

src/report/demo.ts:128-146 answerFor(): the demo interview maps six people onto four canned answers. report.txt therefore shows three identical pairs: Noor = Greta, Chiara = Paweł, Murat = Jan. Noor's answer 'Das neue Café war günstiger…' contradicts her own grid: in R3 she went 'zum Bäcker an der Ecke'. Fix: build each answer from that persona's own history. Name the place they actually went (placeAlternative / wentToRival) and use their quirk (Noor asks about nuts, Jan orders for two, take-away people want a box). Give at least two variants per bucket and never repeat a sentence in one interview. Criterion: honest summary; the interview is the owner's take-home. Check: the 6 interview answers in report.txt are distinct, and every place named matches that persona's grid.

src/sim/rehearsal.ts chooseLine (~1092) and the round-3/4 line tags: the rule-based stand-in now contradicts itself in new ways, and three of them are in the shipped demo. Jan's R3 diary says 'Zum ersten Mal das Angebot … probiert' after his R2 try. Murat's R4 says 'Paweł erwähnt das Angebot auch ständig' while Paweł's R4 says 'hab vergessen, dass es das Angebot gibt'. Noor ignores the board in R1 ('Nicht stehen geblieben') yet asks 'Kann ich das Getränk gegen einen Kaffee tauschen?', and the owner's checklist quotes that question. Sweep of 240 runs: 183 questions from people who ignored the deal; 44 usual_order picks by first-time customers ('mein Übliches' at a café they have never used); 19 cases of forgetting the deal right after telling others; 11 'X keeps mentioning it' while X forgets it; 8 'first time' diaries after an earlier try. Listener lines are formulaic ('{X} meinte…', 'Wieder da, und {X} empfiehlt es auch' in every run). They also ignore the audience: Jan told 'anderen Eltern aus der Kita', yet the links go to Chiara (office) and Murat (night-shift nurse). Fix: gate questionForOwner on having noticed; give 'new' customers 'Bestellt etwas anderes' instead of usual_order; no forgets_about_it after a tell; 'keeps mentioning' only if the teller was public and is not forgetting; set heardFrom only when the teller's stated audience fits the listener. Criterion: story across rounds. Check: extend sim.test.ts:674 with these assertions over 60 seeds.

src/sim/rehearsal.ts:889-891 and :946-948 (EVENT_EFFECTS in berlin.ts): 'busy', 'works' and 'quiet' only change the round-1 notice chance. So baustelle, street_festival and christmas_market injected before round 3 give exactly the same R3-R4 action counts as no event (60 seeds, Neukölln, de). rain_week, bvg_strike and school_holidays change who is around, but no one who is around mentions them (0 of about 260-292 R3 thoughts). Only rival_lunch (eats_elsewhere 53 → 83) and heatwave change the thoughts. Yet the landing promises 'einen BVG-Streik, eine Woche Regen … und sehen, was sich ändert' (site/src/lib/messages-de.ts:142), and autoplay is the no-model path. Fix: give every event an effect in rounds 2-4, plus at least one tagged line per later-round action. Baustelle: take-away and pram customers avoid the café. Festival or Christmas market: more visitors around, queue complaints, Glühwein instead of lunch. BVG strike: commuters away, locals working from home come by more. Also add one event sentence to that round's situation text. Criterion: owner events change behaviour plausibly. Check: a sim test that each of the 8 events changes the R3-R4 counts vs no event and is named in at least 10% of active R3 thoughts.

src/sim/personas.ts ARCHETYPES lunchAlts/channels and src/sim/rounds.ts scenes: only the mix and the name follow the Kiez. With seed 1, Neukölln and Charlottenburg give 5 of 6 identical people (Agnieszka, Kwame, Yasmin, Paula and Bartek; only the slot types shift). The Späti, Döner, Vietnamese place and Bäcker are the same everywhere, and the scene changes only 'Montag, 8:30 Uhr in Charlottenburg'. Fix: add a small per-Kiez flavour table of generic types, with no real business names. Examples: Charlottenburg gets the canteen in the office block, the weekly market stall and the Italian place; Neukölln gets the Späti, the Döner, the Bäckerei and the street market. Add one scene detail per Kiez, and seed names by Kiez so two Kieze give different people. Keep the 'grobe Annahme, keine Statistik' label. Criterion: personas feel like that Kiez. Check: the same seed in two Kieze shares at most 2 of 6 personas, and at least one alternative or channel differs.

Language and wording in step 5. Polish: 'Wyobrażone osoby grały proste, stałe reguły, bez AI' says the people played the rules. Write 'Wyobrażonych klientów odegrały proste, stałe reguły, bez AI'. Spanish mixes 'imaginados' and 'imaginarios', and Polish mixes 'wyobrażone' and 'wymyśleni', in the same section. The German brief shows 'Word of mouth from Jan (vater mit kleinen kindern)': it lowercases a German label. The price checklist writes 'einen flat white' (German capitalises the noun: 'Flat White'). The checklist claims 'erfahren Neues meist auf Google Maps' from a 2-of-4 tie. Say 'zwei von vier' instead. Criterion: honest summary, natural language. Check: the step-5 texts in report-es.txt and report-pl.txt use one word for 'imagined', and the channel line names a count.
